verdicts.summary: [L] states no counterpart of what [M] prints.
evidence: [M] first asserts that two histories at the same N,p with endpoints differing by delta satisfy d <= |delta|/b_* + 8 g_* d, then ball preservation, 1/2-contraction, real identification and fixed-level convergence for the series equations on S(R) x S(X_{m,p}). [L]'s Camp.Cart.veil is a map on PlotN N for a single complex endpoint b; dwindle states only `‖V.veil T N X b z - V.veil T N X b v‖≤ soft*‖z-v‖` at one fixed b, and no declaration in Camp, Spire, Upland or elsewhere compares histories or fixed points at two different endpoints with a |delta|/b_* term (exists_trial gives only uniqueness of the real trial). The first claim has no counterpart, so the item cannot be `parts` and the no-match finding stands; it is a missing assertion, not a typo.

[M] prints the history comparison d <= |delta|/b_* + 8 g_* d between two histories with endpoints differing by delta, plus series-space ball preservation, contraction, uniqueness, real identification and fixed-level convergence. [L]'s Cart.access, dwindle (soft*||z-v||, same b), picked/unique and Arc.uv give the contraction, fixed point and convergence on PlotN N for a complex b in a disc, but no declaration compares two histories with different endpoints (dwindle fixes b), so that claim has no counterpart and the claim stands.
